parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by the specific acoustic impedance of a medium.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The intensity reflection coefficient $\alpha$ is given by the expression
$$\alpha = \frac{(Z_2 - Z_1)^2}{(Z_2 + Z_1)^2}.$$
Explain the meanings of the symbols in this expression.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A parallel beam of ultrasound has intensity $I_0$ as it enters a muscle. The beam passes through a thickness of $3.4\text{ cm}$ of muscle before being incident on the boundary with a bone, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:figure_4_1}}

Fig. 4.1

The intensity of the ultrasound beam as it passes into the bone is $I_{\text{T}}$.

Some data for muscle and bone are given in Fig. 4.2.

{{figure:figure_4_2}}

Fig. 4.2

Calculate the ratio $\frac{I_{\text{T}}}{I_0}$.
